fruits.extendedStory: The name means church of the Holy Spirit. Albrecht Stürler designed it and it was finished in 1729. That makes it baroque, a style that prefers curves and round arches to the pointed shapes of older churches. It stands at 542.2 metres above sea level, on the flat western end of the old town. Bahnhofplatz runs right past the door, in the middle of the bustle.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Name meint den Heiligen Geist, dem die Kirche geweiht ist. Entworfen hat sie Albrecht Stürler, fertig war sie im Jahr 1729. Barock heisst hier: Rundungen statt Spitzen, Rundbogen statt Spitzbogen, ein Stil, der lieber schwingt als aufragt. Sie steht auf 542,2 Metern über Meer, ganz am flachen Westende der Altstadt. Wer über den Bahnhofplatz geht, läuft direkt an ihrer Tür vorbei.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The name means church of the Holy Spirit. Albrecht Stürler designed it and it was finished in 1729. That makes it baroque, a style that prefers curves and round arches to the pointed shapes of older churches. It stands at 542.2 metres above sea level, on the flat western end of the old town. Bahnhofplatz runs right past the door, in the middle of the bustle.

localizedStory.de: Albrecht Stürler baute sie 1729, barock und rundbogig, direkt am Bahnhofplatz.
localizedStory.en: Albrecht Stürler built this one in 1729, baroque and round-arched, right at the edge of Bahnhofplatz.

fruits.name: Heiliggeistkirche
fruits.story: Albrecht Stürler built this one in 1729, baroque and round-arched, right at the edge of Bahnhofplatz.

fruits.extendedStory: The tower is older than the job it is named for. It went up in 1256, part of Bern's outer city wall, where Marktgasse runs today. Then the fire of 1405 took the Zytglogge, and the prisoners quartered there were moved into this tower instead. That went on until 1897, when the last 70 inmates left for a new district prison. Since 2017 the tower has housed the Polit-Forum Bern.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Turm ist älter als das, wofür er heisst. 1256 wurde er gebaut, als Teil der äusseren Stadtmauer, dort wo heute die Marktgasse durchgeht. Dann fiel 1405 der Zeitglockenturm dem Stadtbrand zum Opfer, und die dort einquartierten Gefangenen kamen hierher. So blieb es bis 1897, als die letzten 70 Insassen ins neue Bezirksgefängnis zogen. Seit 2017 beherbergt der Turm das Polit-Forum Bern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tower is older than the job it is named for. It went up in 1256, part of Bern's outer city wall, where Marktgasse runs today. Then the fire of 1405 took the Zytglogge, and the prisoners quartered there were moved into this tower instead. That went on until 1897, when the last 70 inmates left for a new district prison. Since 2017 the tower has housed the Polit-Forum Bern.

localizedStory.de: Käfigturm heisst er, weil er einer war: Bis 1897 sass man hier ein.
localizedStory.en: Käfigturm means cage tower, and it was one: people were locked in here until 1897.

fruits.name: Käfigturm
fruits.story: Käfigturm means cage tower, and it was one: people were locked in here until 1897.

fruits.extendedStory: This is where Switzerland's parliament meets. Hans Wilhelm Auer designed the building and it opened in 1902. The style is Renaissance Revival, which means it borrows the columns and proportions of a much older age on purpose. It reaches 64 metres, so it reads as the tall thing at the end of Bundesplatz. The square in front stays open, and people cross it all day.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Hier tagt das Schweizer Parlament. Hans Wilhelm Auer hat das Gebäude entworfen, eröffnet wurde es im Jahr 1902. Der Stil heisst Neorenaissance, das heisst, er borgt sich Säulen und Verhältnisse aus einer viel älteren Zeit. 64 Meter misst der Bau, damit ist er das Hohe am Ende des Bundesplatzes. Der Platz davor bleibt offen, und den ganzen Tag laufen Leute darüber.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This is where Switzerland's parliament meets. Hans Wilhelm Auer designed the building and it opened in 1902. The style is Renaissance Revival, which means it borrows the columns and proportions of a much older age on purpose. It reaches 64 metres, so it reads as the tall thing at the end of Bundesplatz. The square in front stays open, and people cross it all day.

localizedStory.de: Hans Wilhelm Auer hat es gebaut, 1902 wurde es eröffnet. Vom Bundesplatz aus misst es 64 Meter.
localizedStory.en: Hans Wilhelm Auer built it, and it opened in 1902. From Bundesplatz it rises 64 metres.

fruits.name: Bundeshaus – Parlamentsgebäude
fruits.story: Hans Wilhelm Auer built it, and it opened in 1902. From Bundesplatz it rises 64 metres.

fruits.extendedStory: Before it kept time, this tower kept watch. It went up around 1220 as a defensive tower that doubled as Bern's city gate. Then the city burned on 14 May 1405. The tower came through the fire, and a new bell was cast by that October, five months later. Among the figures up top is Chronos, the old god of time, with a rooster, a lion and the bears.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Bevor der Turm die Zeit hütete, hütete er die Stadt. Um 1220 wurde er als Wehrturm errichtet, der zugleich das Stadttor bildete. Am 14. Mai 1405 brannte Bern. Der Turm überstand das Feuer, und schon im Oktober war die neue Glocke gegossen, nur fünf Monate danach. Oben steht Chronos, der alte Gott der Zeit, dazu Hahn, Löwe und der Bärenreigen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Before it kept time, this tower kept watch. It went up around 1220 as a defensive tower that doubled as Bern's city gate. Then the city burned on 14 May 1405. The tower came through the fire, and a new bell was cast by that October, five months later. Among the figures up top is Chronos, the old god of time, with a rooster, a lion and the bears.

localizedStory.de: Bleib zur vollen Stunde stehen: Oben bewegen sich die Figuren, Chronos, Hahn, Löwe und der Bärenreigen.
localizedStory.en: Stand below on the hour and the figures move: Chronos, a rooster, a lion, and a round of bears.

fruits.name: Zytglogge
fruits.story: Stand below on the hour and the figures move: Chronos, a rooster, a lion, and a round of bears.

fruits.extendedStory: By day he sat in the patent office. His rank there was technical expert, third class, and each evening he came back to this address. He had the second floor. The stretch that mattered was short. Between March and September 1905 he sent out five papers covering three separate subjects. Visitors have been able to walk through the rooms since 1977.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Tagsüber war er Beamter. Einstein arbeitete am Patentamt als technischer Experte 3. Klasse und kam abends in diese Wohnung im zweiten Stock zurück. Von 1903 bis 1905 hat er hier gewohnt. In den Monaten zwischen März und September 1905 veröffentlichte er fünf Arbeiten zu drei verschiedenen Themen. Seit 1977 kann man die Wohnung besuchen. Die Kramgasse läuft direkt unter den Fenstern durch.
localizedExtendedStory.en: By day he sat in the patent office. His rank there was technical expert, third class, and each evening he came back to this address. He had the second floor. The stretch that mattered was short. Between March and September 1905 he sent out five papers covering three separate subjects. Visitors have been able to walk through the rooms since 1977.

localizedStory.de: Einstein mietete hier die Wohnung im zweiten Stock, von 1903 bis 1905. Schau mal hinauf zu den Fenstern.
localizedStory.en: From 1903 to 1905 Einstein lived one floor up, at Kramgasse 49. Look at those windows.

fruits.name: Einsteinhaus
fruits.story: From 1903 to 1905 Einstein lived one floor up, at Kramgasse 49. Look at those windows.

fruits.extendedStory: The church is named for Saint Vincent of Saragossa. Work started in 1421. What you see is Gothic, which means pointed arches and tall windows that carry the eye upward. The building itself stands about 20.7 metres, and the rest is all tower. That ends 100.6 metres up. Stand back on Münstergasse if you want the whole of it in view.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche trägt den Namen des heiligen Vinzenz von Valencia. Angefangen wurde 1421. Was du siehst, ist Gotik: Spitzbogen und hohe Fenster, die den Blick nach oben ziehen. Das Gebäude selbst misst rund 20,7 Meter, alles Weitere ist Turm. Der endet erst bei 100,6 Metern. Stell dich auf der Münstergasse ein Stück zurück, dann hast du ihn ganz im Blick.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church is named for Saint Vincent of Saragossa. Work started in 1421. What you see is Gothic, which means pointed arches and tall windows that carry the eye upward. The building itself stands about 20.7 metres, and the rest is all tower. That ends 100.6 metres up. Stand back on Münstergasse if you want the whole of it in view.

localizedStory.de: 1421 wurde angefangen, der Turm misst 100,6 Meter. Leg den Kopf in den Nacken, dann findest du die Spitze.
localizedStory.en: Building started in 1421, and the tower climbs 100.6 metres. Tip your head back to find the top.

fruits.name: Münster
fruits.story: Building started in 1421, and the tower climbs 100.6 metres. Tip your head back to find the top.

fruits.extendedStory: The building took eleven years. Work ran from 1406 to 1417. The bill came to more than 12,000 gold gulden, which drew a great deal of criticism. People thought it too slow and too dear. Six hundred years on, it is still doing the job it was built for. The cantonal parliament sits here, and the city parliament holds its sessions in the same house.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Elf Jahre hat der Bau gedauert. Von 1406 bis 1417 wurde gearbeitet. Die Rechnung lief auf über 12'000 Goldgulden hinaus, und dafür gab es viel Kritik. Zu langsam und zu teuer, fanden die Leute. Sechshundert Jahre später tut das Haus noch immer, wofür es gebaut wurde. Der Grosse Rat des Kantons tagt hier, und das Parlament der Stadt hält seine Sitzungen im selben Haus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The building took eleven years. Work ran from 1406 to 1417. The bill came to more than 12,000 gold gulden, which drew a great deal of criticism. People thought it too slow and too dear. Six hundred years on, it is still doing the job it was built for. The cantonal parliament sits here, and the city parliament holds its sessions in the same house.

localizedStory.de: Kanton und Stadt tagen beide hier, jeder in seinem eigenen Parlament, unter einem Dach.
localizedStory.en: Two parliaments still sit in this one house: the canton's, and the city's.

fruits.name: Rathaus
fruits.story: Two parliaments still sit in this one house: the canton's, and the city's.

fruits.extendedStory: Notice what your legs are not doing. The old way dropped into the gorge, crossed beside a span dating from about 1255, then climbed back out. Royal traffic put up with that dip for generations. Work here ran from 1840 to 1844 and did away with it. Now the road stays flat, 25 metres clear of the water below. Lean over and measure the drop you never made.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Diese Brücke macht aus einem Abstieg einen geraden Weg. Wer auf der hochmittelalterlichen Königsstrasse unterwegs war, musste den Nydeggstalden hinunter. Unten ging es über die Untertorbrücke von etwa 1255, dann wieder hinauf. Gebaut wurde zwischen 1840 und 1844. Heute läuft die Strasse eben, 25 Meter über dem Wasser. Schau über die Brüstung, dann siehst du das Tal, das du gerade überspringst.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Notice what your legs are not doing. The old way dropped into the gorge, crossed beside a span dating from about 1255, then climbed back out. Royal traffic put up with that dip for generations. Work here ran from 1840 to 1844 and did away with it. Now the road stays flat, 25 metres clear of the water below. Lean over and measure the drop you never made.

localizedStory.de: Vor 1844 ging es hinunter zur Untertorbrücke von etwa 1255 und auf der anderen Seite wieder hinauf.
localizedStory.en: Before 1844 you crossed down at the Untertorbrücke of about 1255, then climbed back up the far side.

fruits.name: Nydeggbrücke
fruits.story: Before 1844 you crossed down at the Untertorbrücke of about 1255, then climbed back up the far side.

fruits.extendedStory: Bears turned up here as war booty. Fighters carried a live one home from a battle in 1513. Two years later a pit was dug for it uphill, beside a square that still borrows its name. Bears reached these lower slopes in 1857, into a moat split down the middle. In 2009 the hillside below became open ground, tilting down to the water. Watch where they choose to sit.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Schau auf den Graben: Er ist in zwei Hälften geteilt. Seit 1857 leben die Bären hier unten nach der Nydeggbrücke. Davor waren sie oben in der Stadt. Ihr Graben wurde 1515 eröffnet, auf dem Platz, der bis heute Bärenplatz heisst. Ein Bär kam 1513 als Kriegsbeute aus der Schlacht von Novara. Am 22. Oktober 2009 wurde der Hang hinunter zur Aare als offene Anlage eröffnet.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Bears turned up here as war booty. Fighters carried a live one home from a battle in 1513. Two years later a pit was dug for it uphill, beside a square that still borrows its name. Bears reached these lower slopes in 1857, into a moat split down the middle. In 2009 the hillside below became open ground, tilting down to the water. Watch where they choose to sit.

localizedStory.de: 1513 brachten Söldner einen lebenden Bären aus der Schlacht von Novara mit, als Kriegsbeute.
localizedStory.en: Swiss soldiers brought a live bear back from the battle of Novara in 1513, as war booty.

fruits.name: Bärengraben
fruits.story: Swiss soldiers brought a live bear back from the battle of Novara in 1513, as war booty.
